description: This file defines a logging utility package 'mlog' that wraps around the 'logr' library, providing configuration, various log level methods, and utility functions for logging in a Mattermost project.

classes.name: Logger
classes.description: A wrapper around logr.Logger providing configuration, level checks, logging methods, and utility functions.

classes.name: LoggerConfiguration
classes.description: A map type for configuring log targets, with methods for validation, appending, and conversion.

methods.name: NewLogger
methods.description: Creates a new Logger instance with optional configuration options.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the logger with JSON or file-based target configurations, with precedence rules.

methods.name: ConfigureTargets
methods.description: Configures the logger with a LoggerConfiguration map directly.

methods.name: LockConfiguration
methods.description: Locks the logger configuration to prevent further changes.

methods.name: UnlockConfiguration
methods.description: Unlocks the logger configuration to allow changes.

methods.name: IsConfigurationLocked
methods.description: Checks if the configuration is currently locked.

methods.name: With
methods.description: Creates a new Logger with additional fields.

methods.name: IsLevelEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific log level is enabled.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Logs a message at a specified level with optional fields.

methods.name: LogM
methods.description: Logs a message at multiple levels.

methods.name: Trace
methods.description: Logs a trace level message.

methods.name: Debug
methods.description: Logs a debug level message.

methods.name: Info
methods.description: Logs an info level message.

methods.name: Warn
methods.description: Logs a warning level message.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Logs an error level message.

methods.name: Critical
methods.description: Logs a critical level message.

methods.name: Fatal
methods.description: Logs a fatal message and exits.

methods.name: HasTargets
methods.description: Checks if any log targets are configured.

methods.name: StdLogger
methods.description: Creates a standard library logger from this logger.

methods.name: StdLogWriter
methods.description: Returns an io.Writer that logs to this logger.

methods.name: RedirectStdLog
methods.description: Redirects the standard library's log output to this logger.

methods.name: RemoveTargets
methods.description: Removes log targets based on a filter function.

methods.name: SetMetricsCollector
methods.description: Sets a metrics collector for all targets.

methods.name: Sugar
methods.description: Creates a less structured, more flexible logger.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes all log targets.

methods.name: FlushWithTimeout
methods.description: Flushes all log targets with a timeout.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the logger, flushing remaining logs.

methods.name: ShutdownWithTimeout
methods.description: Shuts down the logger with a timeout.

methods.name: GetPackageName
methods.description: Reduces a fully qualified function name to its package name.

methods.name: ShouldQuote
methods.description: Determines if a string contains unsafe characters for log output.
